reviews.comment: I took NUTR 481 with Professor Johnston. He is very accessible outside of class. I never thought I'd understand how to critically appraise articles, but Mr. Johnston made it easy to comprehend.  He provides great feedback, so it's hard not to do great in your final paper and oral presentation. I recommend him 100%. He's the best!
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I had him for NUTR-481, and it was one of the courses with the highest value I took. I'm still not an expert at reading literature, but now I feel confident I can review the available data on a topic and come up with an appropriate conclusion. His grading criteria is clear, he gives examples, and he is the best lecturer in the nutrition department.

I had Dr. Johnston for NUTR 481 and I think he is an amazing professor. His passion for teaching and research is apparent through his attitude and his lectures. He made NUTR 481 enjoyable and a truly valuable learning experience. Especially if you plan on going to a professional school for healthcare since he focuses on evidence-based practice.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Professor Johnston truly cares about what he teaches and evidence based practice. I believe this is a newer course at A&M but he was able to provide extremely valuable insight for evaluating different studies and over all applicability. I would absolutely recommend Professor Johnston to any one planning to take this course.
